1503623.steps:
1. Load a firmware and boot with factory default settings.
  2. Navigate to Device>Users>Settings page.

  7. Under User tree for login to server provide the domain name.
  8. Under password type the password for the Administrator/AD user.

  10. Under Directory tab specify the domain name and click "Auto Configure" and save.
  11. Once the LDAP server is populated. On the Test tab, select the LDAP server from the drop down list and select any authentication type to test the successful connection.
  12. Go to Users/Local user page, click the button 'Import from LDAP..'.
  13. Select all and click 'Save selected'.

  2. All the selected users from LDAP will be listed on local user page.
